title: Best Value Cap Table Software in 2026: Why Founders Are Choosing Mantle
summary: See why flat-rate, unlimited-stakeholder pricing makes Mantle the best value cap table software for growing startups.
body_markdown:
Every cap table platform claims to be affordable. Almost none of them are, once you actually hire people.


That’s the trap. You sign up for a free plan. You raise your seed round. You hire five, then ten, then twenty people. Then the invoice shows up, and it has nothing to do with the value you’re getting. It’s a bill for growing.


If you’re searching for the best value cap table software, here’s what that search should actually answer:


- What do the major cap table software platforms actually cost once you scale?
- What does “value” mean beyond a free tier?
- Is switching worth the hassle?


---


## Value is not the same as cheap


A free cap table tool that breaks the moment you cross 25 stakeholders is not good value. Neither is a platform that looks affordable at seed and then jumps to a five-figure quote at Series A.


Real value means three things:


- **The price you see is the price you pay.** No surprise renewal calls or sales rep negotiation just to find out what something costs.
- **Growth doesn’t trigger a new bill.** Hiring or raising a fresh round of funding instantly shouldn’t push you into a more expensive tier.
- **You get founder-grade features, not enterprise bloat.** Scenario modeling, 409A valuations, and SAFE issuance without paying for compliance modules built for public companies.


Judged on those three, most of the category fails.


---


## Where the big players fall short on value


**Carta** publishes exactly one price: free, for companies under 25 stakeholders and $1M raised. Cross that line and every tier above it, Build, Grow, Scale, routes to a sales quote. What you pay depends on negotiation. Founders commonly report five-figure annual contracts once they are past the free tier, and that number climbs with headcount.


**Pulley** starts at $1,200 a year and only includes 25 stakeholders for its Startup plan. The next plan up is $3,500 a year and only includes 40 stakeholders.


The pattern across the category: stakeholder count is the pricing lever.


---


## How Mantle prices differently


Mantle runs on a flat-rate model with unlimited stakeholders on every plan, including its free plan,[Mantle Starter](https://withmantle.com/equity/pricing/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=best-value-cap-table-software) .


- **Starter plan: $0.** Unlimited stakeholders, a full investor-ready cap table, no credit card required.
- **Paid plans: flat rate, not per-seat.** With plans starting as low as $100/month, add your co-founders, your first hires, your law firms, and your investors without a single line item changing.
- **Growth plan: cap table management + 409As.** Mantle’s Growth plan offers its full cap table management platform and one annual 409A valuation in one offering, so you don’t have to juggle two vendors and two separate invoices.


The reasoning behind their pricing model is simple. Your bank doesn’t charge you more because you added someone to payroll. Your cap table platform shouldn’t either. Hiring and issuing equity is the whole point of running a startup. Software that taxes you for doing it well is solving the wrong problem.


---


## Migration is not the tax you think it is


Founders stay on expensive platforms for one reason: they think switching means weeks of manual cap table cleanup. Mantle built Clerk specifically to remove that excuse. Drag in your SAFEs, option grants, and existing cap table export, and Mantle’s AI Assistant, Clerk, helps you build out an audit-ready cap table from your actual documents. Better yet, for paid plans, Mantle offers concierge onboarding, which handles the entire cap table build for you. Just upload your company documents, and you’ll receive your new cap table on Mantle within days.


The switching cost people are afraid of is smaller than the cost of staying on a platform charging them for their own growth.


---


## Best value means built for the stage you’re actually at


The best value cap table software is the one priced for how startups actually grow: unevenly, quickly, and without a full-on finance team to negotiate enterprise contracts.


Mantle gives founders a real free tier with no stakeholder ceiling, a flat rate that doesn’t move when your team does, and 409A valuations bundled instead of upsold. That’s what value looks like when it’s measured against how a startup actually operates and not a sales deck.
